Windows and Linux builds now come from the same release, built by CI, with one `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

**Windows:** `paddle-keys-0.3.2-windows-x64.zip`. Keep `paddle-keys.exe` and `paddle_keys_steam.dll` together. It includes the "Start with Windows" fix for profiles that have no Run key yet.

**Linux:** `paddle-keys-0.3.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`. New in this release:
- `install.sh` in the archive installs to `~/.local/opt/paddle-keys`, adds the app menu entry and offers to install the udev rule (`./install.sh --uninstall` removes everything and takes the Steam hook out of `steam.sh`).
- The udev rule (`70-paddle-keys.rules`) is included, so `--probe` finds the controller without manual setup.
- Arch Linux: a PKGBUILD for `paddle-keys-bin` is in `packaging/arch/` in the repo.

Needs glibc 2.35 or newer, GTK 3 and an AppIndicator library on Linux. Steam Elite mode on both systems is described in the README.

Tested on one unit: USB `2DC8:310B`, device release `0x0114`. This release was tried by hand on Linux; the Windows build is checked by CI (tests and build).
